positions.title: Local CAHSI REU
positions.description: Being mentored by Dr. Bozdag at UNT's BioDiscovery Institute. Designing a network that can be passed to a network propagation algorithm he has helped develop called the PhenoGeneRanker. In creating this network and passing it to the algorithm, we hope to discover and propose novel genes that could be related to Alzheimer's disease.

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description: Researched extending the portability of a dense linear algebra library, by conversion to oneAPI. Research was accepted to the REUNS, WACCPD at SC22, and the SC22 ACM Undergraduate Student Research competition.

company.name: Habitat for Humanity of Denton County

positions.title: Office Assistant
positions.description: Was graciously allowed to continue to work on Saturdays, despite the start of intensive semesters in my degree. Currently renovating the office and will soon oversee the volunteers at the construction of our newest home. Have also been tasked with writing an Employee Handbook for the Executive Assistant position. Continuing to reorganize documents.

positions.title: Executive Assistant
positions.description: My biggest role in this position was ensuring invoices, receipts, donations, etc., were handled accordingly. Importantly, I insured secondary companies had the resources they needed to handle finances of a non-profit organization. I ensured proper online and physical documentation of these processes were taken care of as well. I completed many reorganizational tasks, such as updating the systems in which certain processes were managed and tracked, and I sorted old documents in a manner that allowed for easier location and upkeep. On Saturdays, I help organize and monitor the volunteers at the construction of homes. Proper documentation for these events were managed also.
